# implicitRungeKuttaLieGroupTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [implicitRungeKuttaLieGroupTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/implicitRungeKuttaLieGroupTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  Lie group nodes in the implicit Runge-Kutta solvers (#3288): the spatial slider crank of modelLibrary.py
#           with NodeRigidBodyRotVecLG at the small step 6.25e-5, at which the Newton iteration of LobattoIIIA4 and
#           Radau3 stalled while the composition of rotation vectors rounded rotations below 1e-8 rad to zero; the
#           four methods against the same model with Euler parameters; the composition keeps a rotation of 1e-12 rad.
#           The result is the number of checks that pass plus the Newton iterations per step of the four methods.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-06
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.lieGroupBasics import CompositionRuleForRotationVectors
import numpy as np
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import modelLibrary

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)
checks = []

def SliderCrank(nodeType):
    """the slider crank of modelLibrary.py with the given node type"""
    source = open(modelLibrary.__file__, encoding='utf8').read().replace('nodeType = exu.NodeType.RotationRotationVector',
                                                                          'nodeType = exu.NodeType.' + nodeType)
    library = {}
    exec(compile(source, modelLibrary.__file__, 'exec'), library)
    return library['GetModel']('sliderCrank3D')

def Solve(nodeType, solverType, h=6.25e-5, endTime=0.005):
    """the positions and rotation matrices of the three bodies at the end, and the Newton iterations per step"""
    mbs = SliderCrank(nodeType)
    settings = modelLibrary.SimulationSettings(mbs, stepSize=h, endTime=endTime)
    settings.timeIntegration.automaticStepSize = False
    settings.timeIntegration.adaptiveStep = False
    mbs.SolveDynamic(settings, solverType=solverType)
    it = mbs.sys['dynamicSolver'].it
    values = []
    for body in range(3):
        values += list(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0, 0, 0]))
        values += list(np.array(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.RotationMatrix)).flatten())
    return (np.array(values), it.newtonStepsCount/it.currentStepIndex)

u = 0
for solverType in [exu.DynamicSolverType.TrapezoidalGGL, exu.DynamicSolverType.LobattoIIIA4,
                   exu.DynamicSolverType.LobattoIIIC4GGL, exu.DynamicSolverType.Radau3]:
    (lieGroup, iterations) = Solve('RotationRotationVector', solverType)
    eulerParameters = Solve('RotationEulerParameters', solverType)[0]
    difference = np.max(np.abs(lieGroup - eulerParameters))
    exu.Print(str(solverType).split('.')[-1], ': Lie group against Euler parameters', difference, ', iterations per step', iterations)
    checks += [difference < 1e-8 and iterations <= 4]
    u += round(iterations, 1)

#a small rotation composed with the zero rotation and with a rotation
checks += [np.max(np.abs(CompositionRuleForRotationVectors(np.zeros(3), np.array([1e-12, 0, 0])) - [1e-12, 0, 0])) < 1e-24]
v0 = np.array([0.3, -0.2, 0.5])
checks += [np.max(np.abs(CompositionRuleForRotationVectors(v0, np.zeros(3)) - v0)) < 1e-15]

u += sum(checks)
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of implicitRungeKuttaLieGroupTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
